description: HTML template formatter and linter (Django, Jinja, Twig, Nunjucks, Handlebars, Liquid, Go templates, Mustache, Tera, Askama)
config.blankLineAfterTag: Add an additional blank line after `{% <tag> ... %}` tag groups. Blank lines are never added to the end of a block. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.blankLineBeforeTag: Add an additional blank line before `{% <tag> ... %}` tag groups. Blank lines are never added to the start of a file or block, or between similar tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.closeVoidTags: Add a closing mark to known void tags, so that `` becomes ``. Requires djLint ≥ 1.26.
config.configuration: Path to the configuration file. Relative paths, including a bare filename, are resolved from the workspace root. Requires djLint ≥ 1.13 for .djlintrc format and ≥ 1.34 for TOML.
config.customBlocks: Names of custom template blocks to indent, such as `toc` for `{% toc %}...{% endtoc %}`. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.customHtml: Names of custom HTML tags to indent, such as `mjml` or `simple-greeting`. A name can be a regex, as in `mj-\w+`. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.enableLinting: Lint for common issues. Set it per language: turned on for all languages, it lints every file you open, Python and JavaScript included.
config.executablePath: Path to the `djlint` executable, or a bare command name to look up on PATH. A relative value containing a path separator is resolved from the workspace root. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${userHome}` and `${env:NAME}` are expanded. When empty or without a working djLint, djLint is looked for through `#djlint.pythonPath#`, the active Python environment and PATH, and the bundled djLint is used if none is found.
config.exclude: Override the default exclude paths. Applies to the file in the editor from djLint 1.49. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.extendExclude: Add additional paths to the default exclude. Applies to the file in the editor from djLint 1.49. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.formatAttributeJsJson: Format JavaScript and JSON code inside HTML attributes, such as `onclick`, `x-*` and other JavaScript-related attributes. Objects with fewer properties than `#djlint.formatAttributeJsJsonMinProps#` are left on a single line. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.
config.formatAttributeJsJsonMinProps: Minimum number of properties a JavaScript/JSON object must have to be formatted. Objects with fewer properties stay on a single line. Leave unset for djLint's default of 2. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.
config.formatAttributeJsJsonPattern: Regex matching the attributes to format as JavaScript. Leave empty for djLint's default, which matches common JavaScript attributes such as `onclick` and `x-*`, along with Vue.js, Alpine.js and Angular directives. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.
config.formatAttributeTemplateTags: Format template syntax inside tag attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.formatCss: Also format the contents of `<style>` tags, using css-beautify. Template syntax inside them is not fully supported. Requires djLint ≥ 1.9.
config.formatLanguages: Language IDs for which djLint should be registered as a formatter.
config.formatJs: Also format the contents of `<script>` tags, using js-beautify. Template syntax inside them is not fully supported. Requires djLint ≥ 1.9.
config.ignore: Linter codes to skip. Requires djLint ≥ 0.1.5.
config.ignoreBlocks: Template blocks that do not indent their contents. The children are treated as siblings of the block and indented accordingly. Requires djLint ≥ 1.24.
config.ignoreCase: Do not attempt to fix the case of known html tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.23.
config.importStrategy: Which djLint to run. See [Which djLint is used](https://github.com/djlint/djlint-vscode#which-djlint-is-used).
config.importStrategy.fromEnvironment: Use an installed djLint if one is found, otherwise the bundled one.
config.importStrategy.useBundled: Always use the bundled djLint, whatever is installed. `#djlint.executablePath#`, `#djlint.pythonPath#` and `#djlint.useVenv#` are ignored.
config.include: Linter codes to turn on that are off by default. Requires djLint ≥ 1.20.
config.indentCss: Indent width for the contents of `<style>` tags, used when `#djlint.formatCss#` is enabled. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.indentJs: Indent width for the contents of `<script>` tags, used when `#djlint.formatJs#` is enabled. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.keepBrInline:
Keep `
` on the line of the text it breaks, rather than giving it a line of its own. `
` is unaffected. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.
config.lineBreakAfterMultilineTag: When a tag's attributes are spread over lines, start its content on a new line. Requires djLint ≥ 1.27.
config.lintOnType: Lint after a short pause in typing, as well as on opening and saving. Needs `#djlint.enableLinting#`.
config.maxAttributeLength: The formatter spreads a tag's attributes over lines once they are longer than this. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.maxBlankLines: Keep at most this many blank lines in a row. Leave unset for djLint's default of 0, which removes blank lines. Has no effect when `#djlint.preserveBlankLines#` is enabled, since that keeps every blank line. Requires djLint ≥ 1.31.
config.maxLineLength: The formatter joins some HTML and template tags onto one line only when the line fits within this length. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.
config.nameEndblocks: Write the block's name into the `{% endblock %}` that closes it, where the block is written across lines. This is what `T003` asks for. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.
config.noEntityFormatting: Do not rewrite an entity reference as the character it names, so `©` is left as written rather than becoming ©. The entities that carry syntax, and the invisible ones, are never rewritten either way. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.
config.noFunctionFormatting: Do not attempt to format the arguments of function calls inside `{{ }}` expressions. Requires djLint ≥ 1.30.2.
config.noIndentInnerHtml: Do not indent `<head>` and `<body>` below `<html>`, which is how the built-in VS Code HTML formatter lays a document out. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.
config.noLineAfterYaml: Do not add a blank line after YAML front matter. Requires djLint ≥ 1.29.
config.noSetFormatting: Do not attempt to format the contents of `{% set %}` tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.30.2.
config.preserveBlankLines: Preserve blank lines where possible. Ideal for non-html template files where blank lines are intentional. Requires djLint ≥ 1.3.
config.preserveClassNewlines: Preserve line breaks inside multiline class attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.39.
config.preserveLeadingSpace: Preserve leading space on text where possible. Ideal for non-html template files where text indent is intentional. Requires djLint ≥ 1.2.
config.profile: Set a profile for the template language. The profile enables the linter rules that apply to that language, and may also change reformatting. Requires djLint ≥ 0.4.5; the `askama`, `tera` and `liquid` profiles require djLint ≥ 1.42, and `all` requires djLint ≥ 1.44.
config.profile.unset: Do not pass a profile, so djLint uses the one from your configuration file, or its own default.
config.profile.all: Every template language at once. A rule that does not hold for one of them is skipped.
config.profile.jinja: Jinja templates. Use this one for MiniJinja too.
config.profile.tera: Tera templates. Use this one for Zola too.
config.profile.askama: Askama templates, Jinja-style templates in Rust. Rust expressions are never reformatted.
config.profile.html: Plain HTML, with no template syntax.
config.pythonPath: Path to a Python interpreter used to run `python -m djlint`, or a bare command name to look up on PATH. A relative value containing a path separator is resolved from the workspace root. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${userHome}` and `${env:NAME}` are expanded. When empty or without a working djLint, the active Python environment is tried next (see `#djlint.useVenv#`).
config.quoteStyle: Quotes to use for strings inside template tags. `T002` asks for the same quotes, and the formatter uses them in conditions such as `{% if x == "a" %}`, so one file does not spell the same string both ways. Quoting of HTML attributes is left to `H008`. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.
config.quoteStyle.unset: Do not pass a quote style, so djLint uses the one from your configuration file, or its own default of double quotes.
config.requirePragma: Only format or lint files that start with a comment with the text `djlint:on`. The comment can be an HTML comment or a comment in the template language given by `#djlint.profile#`. Requires djLint ≥ 0.5.8.
config.rules: Path to a custom rules file in .djlint_rules.yaml format. Relative paths, including a bare filename, are resolved from the workspace root. Requires djLint ≥ 1.41.
config.singleAttributePerLine: When an opening tag wraps, put the tag name, each attribute and the closing bracket on separate lines. Requires djLint ≥ 1.40.
config.sortAttributes: Sort attributes by name, with `id` first and `class` second. A tag whose attributes are guarded by a template tag keeps the order it was written in, since moving one out of its branch would change the page. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.
config.sortLoadTags: Sort the libraries in `{% load %}` tags and drop the ones written twice, so `{% load static i18n %}` becomes `{% load i18n static %}`. In `{% load a b from library %}`, the names before `from` are sorted. Where two libraries define a tag or filter of the same name, the one loaded last wins, so sorting can change which one a template uses. Requires djLint ≥ 1.47.
config.useEditorIndentation: Get the number of indent spaces from VS Code (see the `#editor.tabSize#` setting). Disable to get it from the djLint config file. Requires djLint ≥ 0.4.3.
config.useGitignore: Add .gitignore excludes to the default exclude. Applies to the file in the editor from djLint 1.49. Requires djLint ≥ 0.5.9.
config.useVenv: When enabled, run djLint with the Python interpreter of the active environment if neither `#djlint.executablePath#` nor `#djlint.pythonPath#` gives a working djLint. The environment is read from the Python Environments extension (`ms-python.vscode-python-envs`) when `python.useEnvironmentsExtension` is on, otherwise from the Python extension (`ms-python.python`).
untrustedWorkspaces: In an untrusted workspace, only the bundled djLint runs, and it reads no files.
